specs.title: Flutterwave adapter
specs.why: A second provider proves the payment port is a real abstraction and unblocks non-Nigerian markets.
specs.scope: Second `PaymentProvider` implementation for Flutterwave. Tenant picks the provider at setup. Contract tests run against both providers in sandbox.
acceptance: Both providers pass the same contract tests
A tenant can switch provider without data loss
Ledger writes are identical in shape

specs.title: WhatsApp provider abstraction
specs.why: Every messaging feature depends on this port, and isolating it keeps the rest testable without a live channel.
specs.scope: `WhatsAppProvider` port and Meta Cloud API adapter. Template message catalog for confirm, remind, cancel and reschedule. Document the template approval process.
specs.non_goals: Template approval and a live business number are human prerequisites. Build against the port with a fake adapter so tests pass without them.
acceptance: A sandbox send returns 200 and a message ID
Templates are defined in code and documented
The adapter is swappable for tests
